Method of Attack: Mimics popular 'requests' library to target macOS devices
Contains Sliver C2 binary hidden inside a 17MB PNG image file using steganography
Installation script decodes base64 string to run system command to retrieve UUID
Validates target system by UUID before extracting and executing Sliver binary
Writes Sliver binary to local file with executable permissions and launches it in background
Attack Vector: Malicious Python package on PyPI disguised as legitimate 'requests' library
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious package versions 2.27.1 and 2.27.2 on PyPI
PNG image file containing Go binary with Sliver implant
